subject: english
stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “He stared at the empty page for a long time”?
options: They are waiting to be fixed
Grace almost never spoke in class
He was afraid of making mistakes
Chocolate can be dangerous for dogs

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They are waiting to be fixed」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Grace almost never spoke in class」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「he was afraid of making mistakes」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Chocolate can be dangerous for dogs」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
